##  Zusätzliche Scores und Indikatoren 
Finanzielle Stärke
Der Creditsafe Financial Strenght Indicator analysiert die Liquidität und Stärke der Finanzlage eines Unternehmens. Der Indikator analysiert ausschließlich die Stärke der letzten Jahresabschlüsse des Unternehmens. 
Geschätzter Jahresumsatz
Der geschätzte Jahresumsatz ist eine Schätzung von Creditsafe für Unternehmen, die zwar einen Jahresabschluss vorlegen, aber keine Umsatzzahlen in ihrer Gewinn- und Verlustrechnung ausweisen. Die Schätzungen werden anhand von Eckdaten aus der Bilanz des Unternehmens und Kennzahlen aus den Abschlüssen anderer Unternehmen aus derselben Branche berechnet. 
Augur Score
Der Augur Score (0-600) ist ein empirisch abgeleiteter Bonitäts-Score, der die Wahrscheinlichkeit des Scheiterns eines Unternehmens in den nächsten 12 Monaten vorhersagt. 
Graydon Bewertung
Das Graydon-Rating zeigt den Grad des Kreditrisikos an, wobei AAA die höchstmögliche und C die niedrigste Bewertung darstellt. D bedeutet, dass sich der Kunde in einem Insolvenzverfahren befindet. N/A bedeutet, dass keine Bewertung festgelegt werden konnte, weil das Unternehmen passiv ist.

# ENG- General Manager (fulltime)
**Location:** Corroios, Portugal & Middelharnis, The Netherlands  
Thermoheat Portugal is seeking for an accomplished and professional General Manager to manage all business operations and expand our company further. An exciting role which requires determination and ambition but gives you a lot of opportunities in return.
**Main tasks / responsibilities  
** Thermoheat is a Dutch international organization that provides customers a wide range of Refractory products and services. We design, supply and install heat resistant products in various primary industries such a petrochemical, chemical industry, metal industry and offshore. With more than 40 years of experience in this niche market, Thermoheat is a valued partner in The Netherlands and abroad.
In this roll role, you will be responsible for leading the Thermoheat-Office in Portugal on a daily basis. Your responsibilities will have a wide range.
**An overview of General Management responsibilities:**
1. Responsible for developing and executing the company’s business strategies;   
2. Able to provide strategic advice to the Director and Management team of Thermoheat B.V (The Netherlands).;   
3. Prepare and implement comprehensive business plans to facilitate achievement by planning cost- effective operations and market development activities;   
4. Ensure company policies and legal guidelines;   
5. Communicate and maintain a good relationship with all relations and act as a public relations representative of the company.   
6. Oversee the company’s financial performance, investments and other business ventures;   
7. Supervise the work of executives providing guidance and motivation to drive maximum performance.   
8. Monitor daily operations and address potential issues when they arise;   
9. Coordinate with the HR/administration department to ensure our hiring plan meet our business needs;   
10. Responsible for HSE within the business unit;   
11. Responsible for HR within the business unit;   
12. Responsible for the daily execution of Sales- Engineering- and administrative- departments within Thermoheat Portugal.
**Required profile:  
** This role necessitates strong communication and influencing trough collaboration, internally externally. To be successful in this role, you should be a thoughtful leader and a confident decision-maker, helping our people develop and be productive, while ensuring our profits are on the rise.
Requirements:   
- Proven experience in a managerial position or similar executive role;   
- Degree in business, Management or related field;   
- Experience in Refractory industry (or similar) for at least 7 years;   
- Excellent understanding of the local requirements both from legal and business perspective;   
- Knowledge of business process and functions (finance, HR, procurement, operations)   
- Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills;   
- Outstanding analytical and problem-solving abilities;   
- Experience with budgeting and forecasting;   
- English, French and Portuguese language in word and writing   
- The ability to travel abroad (The Netherlands, Spain, France)
**The company offers:   
**Of course, there is something in return! Within Thermoheat we value initiative and pro-activity in which you are given the possibility to think along with us. We are located in a very dynamic, international environment with many possibilities. At Thermoheat you’ll get the opportunity to further develop and professionalize.
We offer:   
- A challenging and exiting job with a high level of independence;   
- A challenging salary;   
- Daily food allowance;   
- Company car;   
- Laptop & phone;   
- 22 vacationdays based on a full-time employment;   
- A pleasant and international working atmosphere;

# ENG- Refractory Engineer (Fulltime) 
**Location:** Corroios, Portugal/ Middelharnis, The Netherlands   
Do you have a passion for innovation and a dedication to safety? Do you want to work on a essential part of many industrial processes? Thermoheat might have an interesting challenge for you!
**Main tasks / responsibilities:  
** As a Refractory Engineer, you are responsible for the designing of refractory systems. Refractories are essentially non-metallic construction materials which are capable of retaining their form and strength at extremely high temperatures, under varying conditions of mechanical stress and chemical attack by or gases liquids or molten and semi-molen materials such as glass metals or slags. The refractory industry is quite complex and constantly evolving so there’s always something new to learn.
In this roll you ensure that the systems are safe and affective and meet all applicable codes and regulations. As a refractory engineer, you will work with customers to determine their specific needs and requirements, such as material selection.
All necessary engineering activities related to Refractory engineering:   
- Refractory design & engineering;   
- Co-ordinate with other departments (sales, projectdepartments) and clients/consultants;   
- Resolve engineering issues;   
- Review customer technical requirements and incorporate in projects related specifications and design drawings;   
- Prepare foundation loading and furnace steel calculations;   
- Inspection of Castable Lining, Ceramic Fibre Lining and Insulation Brick Lining work;   
- Inspection of external insulation works.
**Required profile:   
**The Engineer we are looking for is proactive, assertive and involved but above all enthusiastic and motivated. It is important that you are able to think creatively and come up with an innovative solution to meet the customers need while still staying in budget. The candidate we are looking for has specific knowledge of Refractory, has good communication skills and is good at computer usage.
Further requirements:   
- Minimal 2 years of experience in a similar function;   
- A mechanical/civil Engineering diploma;   
- API 936- certification (Preferable)   
- Knowledge of furnace type of structures and associated components such as burners, ducting, air pre- heaters, stack etc.   
- Familiar with applying 3D- modeling software such as Autocad and SolidWorks;   
- Knowledge of international ISO & VCA standards;   
- Proficient English and Portuguese language in word and writing;   
- The ability to travel abroad.
**The company offers:   
**Of course, there is something in return! Within Thermoheat we value initiative and pro-activity in which you are given the possibility to think along with us. We are located in a very dynamic, international environment with many possibilities.
We offer:   
- A challenging and exiting job with a high level of independence

- Various growth and development opportunities.
